BiblicalUsage: Taanath-shiloh was a landmark on the border of Ephraim, where the boundary went up from Jericho toward the hill country. The name means approach to Shiloh, and the place is named once, as a point on a line. It is one of the Bible's small places, known only because God's people measured their land by it.
TheologicalSignificance: Small border marks matter more than they look: God gave His people a land with edges, and every landmark on the line was part of the gift.
